plugins.name: ai-architect-core
plugins.description: AI-powered requirements engineering and system modeling plugin for Claude — create requirements catalogs, entity models, use case diagrams, and use case specifications through guided slash commands.

plugins.name: ai-architect-testing
plugins.description: AI-powered testing plugin for Claude — document a project-level testing concept, create Playwright E2E tests, Vitest unit tests, structured manual test plans, and generate end-user guides as Word documents with app screenshots, based on interactively built project-specific templates, through guided slash commands.

plugins.name: ai-architect-dev-tools
plugins.description: Developer workflow tools for Claude — create conventional commits, project implementation guidelines, structured use case implementation plans, project-convention code reviews, and GitHub issues with root cause analysis through guided slash commands.

plugins.name: ai-architect-product
plugins.description: Product Owner toolkit for Claude, grounded in Scrum and Evidence-Based Management — write the product vision with a measurable Product Goal, maintain an ordered Product Backlog, and prepare App Store / Google Play submissions (store listing texts within the character limits and device-exact screenshots captured with Playwright) through guided slash commands.
